topology.tree: world -> base_link -> J1 -> link1 -> J2 -> link2 -> J3 -> link3 -> J4 -> link4 -> J5 -> link5 -> J6 -> link6 -> fixed -> gripper

GO_M8010_6.neutral_bearing_policy: accounted inside output equivalent; no additional V1 mass
GO_M8010_6.wiring_policy: accounted inside stator/core equivalent; no additional wire mass

go_m8010_single_with_wiring.name: One GO-M8010-6 with current attached wiring
go_m8010_single_with_wiring.notes: The single physical measurement is the basis for six repeated V1 engineering allocations; it is not added again on top of those allocations.

upper_arm_print.name: Upper-arm 3D printed structure
upper_arm_print.notes: CAD metadata defines one upper arm split into exactly two complementary print parts. No motor, metal fastener, collision proxy or reference object is included.

distal_assembly.name: Damiao motor + GO motor + arm distal end combination
distal_assembly.notes: CAD proves attachment topology but not which detachable items were on the scale. No DM-G6220, Gemini, adapter, fastener or gripper mass is guessed.

forearm_assembly.name: Complete forearm-related assembly
forearm_assembly.mass_equation: M_forearm_assembly = 2.723 kg; nested assembly boundaries unresolved
forearm_assembly.notes: The repository proves link3 contains J3 stator, forearm, J4 stator and fasteners, but does not prove the physical proximal/distal cuts used for weighing.

gripper_connector.name: Gripper plus directly connected connector
gripper_connector.mass_equation: M_gripper_connector = 0.170 kg; Gemini and moving-gripper membership unresolved
gripper_connector.notes: Gemini belongs to gripper in CAD, but CAD attachment does not prove it was present on the physical scale.

required_information: 1087.5 g：请逐项确认 Wrist_Prelink、完整 J5 GO-M8010、J5-to-DM adapter 与 3 颗螺栓、完整 J6 DM-G6220、J6 夹爪连接件与 6 颗螺栓、完整夹爪、Gemini Pro 是否在秤盘上（YES/NO）；或提供带标注的秤盘照片。
2723 g：请确认上述 1087.5 g 子装配是否原样完整包含在本次称重中。
2723 g：请确认近端切口是否从 J3 stator 开始，末端是否包含 gripper 与 Gemini Pro。
170 g：请确认是否包含 Gemini Pro。
170 g：请确认是否包含舍机、固定框、六个夹爪内部活动刚体角色、全部夹爪紧固件，以及 link6 的 DM 输出法兰/六颗连接件螺栓。
170 g：如果包含 Gemini Pro，请另行确认 CAD 未建模的相机安装螺丝及相机随件线材是否在秤盘上。
